title: One-shot Multi-view Visual Conversational Recommendation

problem.claim: Personalized recommendation systems must operate effectively with minimal user input while addressing cold start, transparency, and nuanced preference estimation challenges.

gap.claim: Multi-turn recommendation systems impose user burden and do not directly resolve the stated challenges within a single conversational round.

contributions.claim: Introduces OSMVR, a framework for one-shot multi-view visual conversational recommendation.
Structures recommendation into preference estimation and recommendation generation within a single conversational round.
Uses multiple views for one-shot preference inference and multi-perspective recommendation generation.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors characterize OSMVR as a novel framework.

narrative_sequence.summary: The paper proposes OSMVR to address personalized recommendation from minimal user input.
The framework targets cold start, transparent justification, and nuanced preference estimation challenges.
The recommendation process is organized into preference estimation and recommendation generation in one conversational round.
A multi-view design supports one-shot preference inference and multi-perspective recommendation generation.

unknowns: The abstract does not report datasets, baselines, metrics, results, or experimental conditions.
The abstract does not specify how visual views are constructed or how preference inference is implemented.
The abstract does not provide details about transparent justifications or evaluation of user burden.
